title: Senior Technical Support Specialist - Kubernetes
description:
Senior Technical Support Specialist \- Kubernetes
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Senior Technical Support Specialist plays a critical role in safeguarding business continuity by serving as the primary point of contact for high\-impact technical escalations. This position requires an expert level of knowledge in Kubernetes and other associated technologies to conduct complex support activities, provide technical training, and develop preventative measures that enhance service reliability for both the organization and its customers.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Serve As The Point Of Contact For All High Business\-Impacting Critical Activities And Technical Escalations In Kubernetes Environments, Ensuring Swift Resolution Of Issues.
  

2\. Conduct Complex Support Activities By Diagnosing And Resolving Kubernetes\-Related Incidents While Providing Oversight And Technical Training To Less Experienced Team Members.
  

3\. Collaborate With Customers To Proactively Identify And Implement Preventive Measures That Mitigate Future Defects Within Kubernetes Deployments.
  

4\. Identify Potential Risks In Support Processes And Develop Comprehensive Contingency Plans To Address Them Effectively.
  

5\. Act As A Subject Matter Expert (Sme) In Kubernetes, Delivering Technical Support And Assistance To Both Internal Teams And External Customers, Ensuring High Levels Of Satisfaction And Service Reliability.
  

6\. Aid In The Creation And Development Of Initial Troubleshooting Tools And Resources For Customers, Enhancing The Service Offerings And Improving Response Times To Incidents.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Expert\-Level Proficiency In Kubernetes And Container Orchestration Technologies.
  

2\. Strong Knowledge Of Devops Practices And It Service Management (Itsm) Frameworks.
  

3\. Proficiency In Monitoring Tools To Assess Performance And Availability Of Kubernetes Clusters.
  

4\. Excellent Problem\-Solving Skills And Ability To Perform Complex Troubleshooting.
  

5\. Strong Communication And Interpersonal Skills To Effectively Liaise With Customers And Internal Teams.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Relevant Certifications Such As Certified Kubernetes Administrator (Cka) Or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (Ckad) Are Highly Desirable But Not Mandatory.
  

2\. Itil Certification May Also Be Valuable For Understanding It Service Management Practices.

title: Senior Administrator - ServiceNow, IT Service Management
description:
Senior Administrator \- ServiceNow, IT Service Management
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Tools \& Automation Engineer plays a crucial role in enhancing operational efficiency through the development and maintenance of automation tools. This position focuses on asset management and ITIL processes, ensuring that all solutions align with organizational standards for quality and cost. The engineer will work collaboratively to deliver high\-quality code and support existing projects while responding to client requests.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Adhere To Quality Standards And Regulatory Requirements While Executing Servicenow Functional Consulting Tasks, Ensuring Compliance With Company Policies.
  

2\. Provide Support For Complex Incidents By Performing Root Cause Analysis And Implementing Effective Solutions To Resolve Technical And Security Issues Within The Servicenow Platform.
  

3\. Engage In Value\-Adding Activities Such As Updating And Managing The Knowledge Base, Training New Team Members, And Coaching Analysts On Best Practices In Itil And Itsm Frameworks.
  

4\. Resolve Complex Tickets Within Agreed Slas By Collaborating With Cross\-Functional Support Teams, Ensuring Seamless Operations And Maintaining A Robust Security Posture.
  

5\. Enhance Customer Experience And Csat By Focusing On First Call Resolution, Minimizing Rejected Resolutions And Reopened Cases, And Proactively Mitigating Security Threats.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Advanced Proficiency In Servicenow Functional Consulting With A Strong Understanding Of Itil And Itsm Principles.
  

2\. In\-Depth Knowledge Of Incident Management, Problem Management, And Service Request Processes Within Servicenow.
  

3\. Excellent Analytical And Troubleshooting Skills, With The Ability To Perform Root Cause Analysis And Implement Effective Solutions.
  

4\. Strong Communication And Interpersonal Skills For Effective Collaboration And Customer Interaction.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Itil Foundation Certification Is Optional But Valuable.
  

2\. Servicenow Certified System Administrator Certification Is Optional But Valuable

title: Senior Lead Network Support
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Are you a tech\-savvy problem\-solver with a passion for ensuring optimal network performance? If so, look no further – Kyndryl is seeking a Network Support Specialist who will be the go\-to expert for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting computer networks.
  

  

As our Network Support Specialist, you'll be working in a complex, multi\-vendor environment, and will use your analytical skills to identify and resolve network issues, make configuration changes, and implement security policies. This role requires someone who can think on their feet, test and apply corrective actions (including emergency changes), and participate in change reviews as needed. And with the ever\-changing nature of technology, you'll be constantly learning and growing in your role.
  

  

You will work alongside a talented team of experts to plan and execute routine network changes, troubleshoot and solve network issues and outages, and maintain excellent communication with our end customers, project managers, and service engineers. You’ll be responsible for maintaining network components, monitoring network performance, and maintaining network security. You will also be providing user support for network\-related issues, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support possible.
  

  

If you're ready to take on a fast\-paced and rewarding role in the world of network support, apply to join the Kyndryl team today!
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Skills and Experience
  

  

* Proven knowledge and experience in trouble\-shooting, switching, and routing
* 2\+ years of working experience in Networking
* Minimum CCNP certification or equivalent knowledge
* Experience with Network security, WAN
* Working knowledge of ITIL

  

Preferred Skills and Experience
  

  

* Experience with BGP, Software Defined Networking (SDN) based on Cisco ACI, Checkpoint/Cisco Firepower firewalls, F5 load Balancers, NSX
* Experience with Ansible automation
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Office Admin and IT support executive
description:
The Office Administrator and IT Support Executive is responsible for managing office operations and providing technical support for IT systems. This hybrid role requires strong organizational skills, excellent interpersonal communication, and a solid understanding of IT infrastructure to ensure the smooth functioning of office activities and technical operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesOffice Administration**

* Oversee daily office operations and maintain a well\-organized workspace.
* Manage office supplies inventory, procurement, and vendor relationships.
* Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling meetings, preparing reports, and maintaining documentation.
* Coordinate logistics for events, meetings, and training sessions.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, health, and safety regulations.

**IT Support**

* Provide technical support for hardware, software, and network\-related issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain office IT equipment (desktops, laptops, printers, etc.).
* Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity issues for LAN, WAN, and Wi\-Fi.
* Ensure timely updates and maintenance of operating systems and antivirus software.
* Liaise with external IT service providers and contractors as required.
* Contribute to IT security by managing backups, firewalls, and data recovery plans.

**Qualifications and SkillsEducation and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in office administration and IT support.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and IT management tools.
* Knowledge of operating systems (Windows, macOS) and basic networking concepts.
* Familiarity with troubleshooting common hardware and software issues.
* Experience with database management and cloud platforms is a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* High level of discretion and professionalism.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country, please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.


Job Req Number: 127472  

Time Type: Full Time


Department: Contract Logistics IT  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Position name: Senior IT Specialist  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Position target:  

This position is collaboration and link between DSV’s customers, DSV’s business functions and the regional and global IT departments reporting into the Team Lead BY WMS Core.

  



Tasks and responsibilities:  

STRATEGIC / TACTICAL  

* Collaborate with the Delivery and product function, other relevant DSV departments to support the delivery of business requirements with the standard DSV warehouse systems solutions and identify solutions for potential gaps.
* Collect review \& understand customer requirements and help in the translation of these into BRF/BRS for submission to the build part of IT
* Conduct IT Solution Reviews with IT Delivery team to maximize standardization and reusing existing solutions
* Continuous improvement of the standard warehouse solutions for faster implementation within the regional sites and support the creation of further regional and global standard solutions in the logistics space together with the other regional and global teams
* Maintain and develop the WMS and surrounding applications with high focus on standardization and code reusability, clear and understandable documentation.


GOVERNANCE  

* Adhere to the global and regional governance guidelines defined for all IT solutions and in particular the once in the logistics area
* Assist with code \& solution reviews
* Responsible for being cost conscience
* Support the IT architecture function in its mission, objective and action plans


RESEARCH AND EXPAND THE TOOLBOX FOR WMS SOLUTIONS  

* Research new opportunities for increasing productivity and growing profit within the function of WMS systems
* Communicate and collaborate with the BY WMS Core Lead, BY WMS Delivery Lead \& Director BY WMS on future functionality as market trends/demands are presented
* Collaborate with the Core \& Delivery teams in delivering those functionalities


EXECUTION  

* Act as an IT Technical/Functional resource on key DSV projects
* Provide senior consultancy on technical matters and logistic projects
* Act as interface between the demand functions and IT solutions to ensure internal and external customer requirements are met
* Secure on\-time creation of technical solutions, internal developments
* Analyze customer requirements, recommend, project manage \& manage the implementation of IT solutions in collaboration with business owner/account manager
* Continue to enhance skills through continuing education
* Participate in business implementations and full responsibility for end\-to\-end IT project work stream. Liaise with EDI group to ensure customer IT integration
* Coordinate information \& activities to ensure customer satisfaction in delivering warehouse management solutions
* Collaborate with regional project management team to manage time/resources and successfully deliver IT warehouse systems services
* Create and deliver in person or by teams’ presentations/demos on how IT enables warehouse solutions
* Identify gaps and/or shortcomings of DSV warehouse applications based on own’s observations, knowledge, customer’s requirements and competitor’s systems. Pro\-actively discuss these improvement opportunities with the global WMS teams in both Core and Support areas and where appropriate participate in continous improvement projects related to DSV’s standard warehouse solutions
* Support head of department with ad\-hoc IT projects as required


Special rights:  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Education and skills:  

Minimal requirements  

GENERIC REQUIREMENTS:  

* Ability to navigate and work with BY WMS (previously JDA, RedPrairie Discrete) and deploy applications in a MOCA environment.
* Advanced knowledge of Page Builder and .Net
* Basic knowledge of Java programming language.
* Good SQL command language and knowledge of relational Database.
* Experience with implementing EDI/B2B end to end customer supply chain solutions.
* General knowledge of working with different 3rd party SW providers.
* Capable of taking ownership of and implementing the project, including the end\-user contact, analysis, design, and documentation.
* Proven ability to maintain and implement high quality, reliable WMS solutions.
* Demonstrate thoroughness in system design and system testing with a minimum supervision


PERSONALITY TRAITS:  

* Excellent communication skills both written and oral and the ability to tailor these to the audience
* Ability to work in a diverse multi\-cultural environment
* Ability to move forward successfully with minimal direction: self\-motivated \& autonomous
* Capable of remaining professional \& effective considering sometimes very stressful situations
* Strong analytical skills in relation to logistics processes and the ability to translate these into the standard processes within a tier 1 WMS solution
* Pro\-active and willing to involve stakeholders in decision making process when needed
* Ready to take personal accountability for achieving individual and shared goals
* Able to influence and convince others in a way that results in acceptance, agreement and overall, more efficient and profitable logistics environment
* Credible with vendor, internal / external customers, peers and staff


LEADERSHIP \& MANAGEMENT  

* Demonstrates high levels of integrity
* Acts as a Role Model for Global Values and fully adhere to the Code of Conduct
* High energy and resilience, and calm under pressure
* Demonstrate business and financial awareness
* High commitment and positive attitude in the face of setbacks and obstacles
* Authentic, approachable, open and honest
* Effective listener
  

Minimal work experience:
  

Minimal requirements  

5 years professional experience in a transportation, logistics or supply chain management related role, preferably within the 3PL industry.

**DSV – Global transport and logistics**



Working at DSV means playing in a different league.



As a global leader in transport and logistics, we have been on an extraordinary journey of growth. Let’s grow together as we continue to innovate, digitalise and build on our achievements.



With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we work every day to offer solid services and meet our customers’ needs and help them achieve their goals. We know that the best way to achieve this is by bringing in new talent, fresh perspectives and ambitious individuals like you.



At DSV, performance is in our DNA. We don’t just work – we aim to shape the future of logistics. This ambition fuels a dynamic environment built on collaboration with world\-class team players, accountability and action. We value inclusivity, embrace different cultures and respect the dignity and rights of every individual. If you want to make an impact, be trusted by customers and grow your career in a forward\-thinking company – this is the place to be.
